references.text: Mentions Eshtaol and Zorah as cities in the lowlands of Judah, which were later assigned to the tribe of Dan
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson in Mahaneh-Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol
Samson was buried between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah
The Danites sent spies from Zorah and Eshtaol to explore the land
The spies returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, and 600 Danites set out from there
Explains why Dan had to seek new territory; their original inheritance was too small
Beth-Shemesh (Ir-Shemesh) was given to the Levites from the tribal territories of Judah and Dan
